summary: Join our Green Economy and Sustainable Development Training Course to gain essential knowledge and skills for promoting sustainability in various sectors.
lede: Sustainable development training supports sustainability, ESG, public-sector, NGO, utility, industrial and investment professionals in turning sustainability goals into practical plans. Participants learn to map energy, water, waste and emissions baselines, prioritize interventions, assess climate risks, develop green project concepts, and build indicators and credible ESG reports while accounting for budget, data and delivery constraints.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for a diverse audience of professionals responsible for driving sustainable outcomes within their organizations.
audience: Public sector planners and policy implementers (environment
NGO climate, environment, and livelihoods program leads
Utility managers and technical teams (water, energy
Industrial EHS teams and compliance managers
Finance, investment, and project development professionals
modules: Foundations of the Green Economy and Sustainable Development
Prioritisation and Decision Logic for Green Interventions
Designing Green Economy Strategies That Can Be Implemented
Circular Economy and Resource Efficiency for Real Operations
Climate Risk, Resilience, and Adaptation Planning
Green Projects and Bankable Investment Pipelines
Green Procurement and Sustainable Supply Chains
Managing Trade-offs, Communication, and Stakeholder Pressure
Implementation Planning and the First 90 Days
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of sustainability concepts and experience in project management or organizational strategy.
